status: draft: demonstration values, validate with NASA HRP sources and a physician

green: Complete prescribed daily cycle ergometer / ARED countermeasure session
yellow: Verify cabin life support parameters (CO2, total pressure, O2 fraction)
Remain in neutral body posture and schedule re-measurement in 20 minutes
red: Broadcast medical alert to crew and mission control
Don emergency mask with 100% O2 supply
Continuous vital monitoring and mandatory re-measurement in 5 minutes

yellow: Reduce metabolic workload and pace in suit
Notify EVA partner of elevated exertion heart rate
Monitor suit telemetry (CO2 levels and PLSS O2 consumption)
Re-measure in 20 minutes before resuming critical tasks
red: Broadcast critical contingency to airlock and EVA partner
Verify suit pressure integrity (4.3 psi) and continuous O2 delivery

yellow: Pause habitat surface operations and inspect life support system
Log symptoms locally (accounting for Earth transmission latency)
red: Activate autonomous local medical contingency protocol
Transmit high-priority telemetry packet to Earth
Administer supplementary oxygen from habitat medical rack
Onboard medical officer assumes direct intervention

hypoxia: Immediately check ambient O2 concentration and cabin/suit pressure
If in cabin, don 100% O2 mask
If in EVA, verify PLSS O2 flow and initiate airlock ingress
eva_strain: Immediately halt translation or tool operations
Adopt neutral rest posture inside spacesuit
Increase liquid cooling garment (LCG) flow if hyperthermic
fluid_shift: Maintain neutral posture to facilitate fluid redistribution
Avoid Valsalva maneuvers or repeated head flexion
Monitor visual acuity and document headache progression
orthostatic_intolerance: Assume supine posture or elevate lower extremities
Engage lower-body compression garments if available
hyperthermia_fever: Suspend physical exertion and remove excess thermal layers
Re-evaluate core temperature in 20 minutes and consider antipyretic protocol
reactive_hypertension: Rest quietly for 15 minutes in neutral microgravity posture
Avoid stimulant intake and reduce acoustic stress in cabin
